svg.text: Kernel pipeline comparison — FlagMega swimlane template
Light theme, shared relative scale, explicit dependencies and evidence classes
SYNTHETIC EXAMPLE — illustrative timings; hardware activity is not measured.
Panels compare separate invocations on the same relative scale; concurrency is interpreted within a panel.
Blank time is unclassified. Thin vertical marks are points. Stacked bars show overlapping intervals, not extra warps.
synthetic-baseline · One CTA; two consumer WGs and one producer role
Clock: illustrative relative ns; resolution: 32 ns; alignment: synthetic
All timings are invented for the template. Producer copy envelopes do not establish TMA busy time.
WG0 / Consumer 0: Physical warps 4–7; illustrativePhysical warps 4–7; illustrative
WG1 / Consumer 1: Physical warps 8–11; illustrativePhysical warps 8–11; illustrative
Producer: Physical warps 0–3; illustrativePhysical warps 0–3; illustrative
CUDA Core / SIMT: SM 0; modeled activitySM 0; modeled activity
Tensor Core: SM 0; modeled concurrent workSM 0; modeled concurrent work
TMA activity: SM 0; busy intervals unavailableSM 0; busy intervals unavailable
B1 · WG0 / Consumer 0 · 1–10 μs · 9 μs · starvation · critical path: yes
Consumer waits for K0; follow the producer issue and completion observations. Evidence: Synthetic dependency example; real diagnosis requires matching counters/instructions.
B2 · WG0 / Consumer 0 · 18–21 μs · 3 μs · starvation · critical path: unknown
K1 becomes ready after the consumer requests it; whole-kernel criticality is unresolved. Evidence: Synthetic example of an explicitly unknown critical-path result.
synthetic-candidate · Same illustrative CTA and role topology
Clock: illustrative relative ns; resolution: 32 ns; alignment: synthetic
A shorter illustrated wait is a hypothesis, not a measured speedup or root-cause proof.
WG0 / Consumer 0: Physical warps 4–7; illustrativePhysical warps 4–7; illustrative
WG1 / Consumer 1: Physical warps 8–11; illustrativePhysical warps 8–11; illustrative
Producer: Physical warps 0–3; illustrativePhysical warps 0–3; illustrative
CUDA Core / SIMT: SM 0; modeled activitySM 0; modeled activity
Tensor Core: SM 0; modeled concurrent workSM 0; modeled concurrent work
TMA activity: SM 0; busy intervals unavailableSM 0; busy intervals unavailable
B1 · WG0 / Consumer 0 · 1–6 μs · 5 μs · starvation · critical path: yes
Producer makes K0 ready earlier; compare with the baseline on the same relative scale. Evidence: Synthetic prediction; validate with uninstrumented timing and actual WG/module captures.
